context_image.usage_description: Top three are actual Tibia reference costumes and pixel craft. Bottom is the immutable target Citizen pose. Adopt craft and costume richness, not reference weapons, poses or identical outfit.

description: DUSKSTRIDER: an elite arcane ranger with a wide angular midnight-purple brimmed travel hat, one large silver diamond hat clasp; a layered deep petrol-blue leather cuirass with a short sculpted back mantle, dark articulated bracers and high strapped boots. A broad diagonal belt and ONE turquoise rune clasp give a deliberate focal point. Refined Hunter/Assassin/Ranger richness and silhouette, entirely original clothes. The mantle is a broad dark back surface, never narrow hanging strips beside the hands. No feathers or face mask. Native Tibia 8.60 pixel art for a paid original outfit, not a recolor of the starter. Top context images are REAL Tibia costume/pixel-style references only; the bottom CITIZEN is the exact pose target. Keep his fixed face, eyes, two hands, shoulder-elbow-wrist pose and foot positions unchanged. Exactly TWO arms following those original wrist anchors. No additional skin anywhere in the mask. Clearly separate sleeves/bracers from the existing peach hands with dark cuffs. No pale fleshy sleeve panels. New headgear is allowed only in the masked hair/head margin; never redraw a face inside headgear. Same south-facing oblique camera and roughly 32px body, with modest extra headgear height. Rich deliberate 2-3px clusters, strong silhouette, layered shading like the references, dark outlines and upper-left light. Distinct materials, no noisy confetti or smooth antialiasing. No weapons, shields, pets, detached ornaments, glow, shadows, words, panel borders or extra body parts. Transparent background.
stage: south idle design study only, no integration or completed animation
